Name: Simple Spooky Season
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎃 Simple Spooky Season[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🎃 Halloween Furniture[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Decorate with [b]96 Halloween furniture pieces[/b]: tables, chairs, benches, sofas, rugs, plants, wall decorations, figurines, piano and organ displays, and decorative hearths.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54042/54042-1792255575-1008076236.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🛍 Furniture Catalogue[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Buy the [b]Spooky Season Catalogue[/b] from [b]Robin for 50,000g[/b], year-round.
Place it and use your normal interact control to choose from [b]all 96 pieces, free and unlimited[/b]. The catalogue is reusable.
Robin sells the catalogue only from this collection.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54042/54042-1792255583-1867313474.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🌐 Languages[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Item names and settings are available in twelve languages.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54042/54042-1792255575-1910461942.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#C4B5D9]Preview images use isolated PC game test renders, not live gameplay screenshots.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📦 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url].
Extract [b]SimpleSpookySeasonHD[/b] into [b]Mods[/b], replacing the previous edition of that folder.
This is a standalone collection; the earlier Spooky Season mod and Fashion Sense are not required.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Benches and sofas support normal seating. The piano, organ and hearth displays are decorative; they do not play music or light fires. Storage-looking pieces, food and the scarecrow display do not provide storage, edible food or crop protection.
Multiplayer has not been tested. Please try a copied save first.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please post reports and ideas on this mod’s page.
[b]Bugs:[/b] Include the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce, and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if helpful.
[b]Suggestions:[/b] Tell me what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
